title: Student V0.1 Wave 1 — Learning/runtime semantics
purpose: Implement v4 Learning/runtime semantics, explicit v2/v3/v4 admission, learner-safe projection and non-scored lesson/flashcard session completion without owning UI rendering or authoring/factory behavior.
invariants: v4 admission is explicit and fail-closed.
lesson and flashcard advance session state without correctness, validation, mastery, transfer or spaced-review evidence.
qcm/fill/constructed/matching/order/classify scoring secrets never cross learner-safe ActivityPresentation.
No UI markup or raw DOM response reading is implemented in this role.
No new persistent schema is introduced solely to count lesson/flashcard exposure.
No source-manifest or workflow edit occurs before JOB 04 fan-in.
requiredEvidence: Exact common Wave 1 base is proven.
v3 constructed semantics pass independently of PR #376 history.
v4 matching/order/classify positive and adversarial evaluation tests pass.
lesson/flashcard completion advances the active session and produces no correctness/mastery evidence.
learner-safe projections match WAVE1_INTERFACE_FREEZE.md and contain no secrets.
changed paths are a subset of allowedPaths.
adversarialTests: Unknown contract or activity type must fail closed.
Duplicate, unknown, omitted or extra IDs in matching/order/classify responses must be rejected.
Any scoring secret present in learner-safe ActivityPresentation fails the boundary test.
Any lesson/flashcard success, failure, validation, mastery, transfer or spaced-review evidence fails qualification.
Any write outside allowedPaths fails scope.
nonGoals: Adding backend, accounts, remote scoring, new persistence schema or plugin infrastructure.
Editing central build, source-manifest or workflow routing before JOB 04.
independentReview: JOB 02 owns UI mechanics independently and must not be used to self-certify Learning semantics.
JOB 05 contradictory QA will independently attack the integrated result after FAN-IN A.
JOB 04 integrates reviewed exact role heads without silently repairing JOB 01 code.
rollback: Drop the JOB 01 commits/branch. The merged v4 architecture remains design authority and no learner data migration is required.
